statement.document_title: Please don’t trust your chatbot for medical advice

our_interpretation: Typical means characteristic, recurring failure modes across models, not behavior present in every answer or a claim that most answers are false.
Problematic in medicine means capable of undermining reliable medical information or decisions; it does not require demonstrated patient injury.
The contextual reference to approximately year-old testing identifies a 2025-to-publication evidence period. Generalization to all current versions remains qualified.
criteria.support_condition: Independent evaluations across multiple LLMs document recurring fabricated content, factual errors and unjustified certainty in medically relevant tasks.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Broad comparable evaluations show these failures are exceptional, confined to isolated systems, or immaterial to medical information and decisions.
